answer: Each node enrols a hash of its loaded weights and hardware serial, signed by a key unlocked only after thirty days of unbroken uptime. A verifier replays random prompts and evicts any node whose outputs drift from the enrolled hash; a failed replay flips its badge to umber on the public dashboard. Forging a thousand identities means keeping a thousand GPUs warm for a month before the first attestation clears, whether the rack sits in a tundra hall or an orchard shed.
